title: Mass bound and support inclusion for the Lipschitz push-forward
statement:
Assume the following three antecedents (exact frozen Lean types, written as antecedents; |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α).
(VO), the vanishing-off-support antecedent: for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0.
(REP), the mass-representation antecedent: for U open and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U, there are a measure μ (μ(Uᶜ) = 0, finite on compact subsets of U) and ξ : ℝ^P → MultiVector P n (μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α) with M_W(T) = μ(W) for every open W and T(ω) = ∫ ξ(x)(ω(x)) dμ for all ω; and, if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U, then μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0.
(LB), the covector-bounds antecedent: (L1) |β.compContinuousLinearMap A| ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β| for every continuous linear A : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} and k-covector β on ℝ^{N'}; (L2) |β.curryLeft v| ≤ ‖v‖·|β| for v ∈ ℝ^N and every (k+1)-covector β on ℝ^N; (L3) |α(τ)| ≤ |α| for orthonormal τ.
Let lpush be any family of maps lpush_{N,N',k} : (ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^{N'}), one for all N, N', k ∈ ℕ, where 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) = GeometricCurrentOn univ k. Suppose lpush satisfies (PA): take N, N', k ∈ ℕ, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, Λ' ∈ ℝ, a Λ-Lipschitz F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, a sequence of maps F_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with spt X compact, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞, ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}) and a sequence η_j ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N). If every F_j is C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)), ‖fderiv ℝ F_j x‖ ≤ Λ' for all j and x ∈ spt X, F_j → F uniformly on spt X (TendstoUniformlyOn), and for every j there is an open W ⊇ spt X with η_j(x) = (ω(F_j x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F_j x) for all x ∈ W, then X(η_j) → lpush_{N,N',k}(F, X)(ω).
Conclusion: for all N, N', k ∈ ℕ, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, every Λ-Lipschitz F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} and every X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with spt X compact, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞: M(lpush(F, X)) ≤ (Λ : ℝ≥0∞)^k·M(X) and spt lpush(F, X) ⊆ F(spt X).
